title: Day 680 — Mexican Air Force Sends 19.5 Tonnes of Earthquake Aid to Colombia
detail: On August 12, 2026 (Day 680, Wednesday), two Mexican Air Force aircraft departed Felipe Ángeles International Airport for Pereira, Colombia, carrying 854 food packages (19.5 tonnes) of humanitarian aid plus Army support personnel, following Colombia's formal request for specific relief items through the Foreign Ministry. Sheinbaum said additional shipments on August 13 and 14 would bring the total to 2,562 food packages (58.5 tonnes), including water and medicine, destined for the hardest-hit cities: Pereira, Manizales, Cali, and Quibdó, after Monday's 7.4-magnitude earthquake killed more than 200 people.

media.caption: Mexican Air Force aircraft depart AIFA with 19.5 tonnes of aid for earthquake-hit Colombia

title: Day 680 — Sheinbaum Meets Goldman Sachs President Waldron to Discuss Plan México Investment
detail: On August 12, 2026 (Day 680, Wednesday), President Sheinbaum met at the National Palace with Goldman Sachs President and COO John E. Waldron, alongside Finance Secretary Edgar Amador Zamora, to discuss Mexico's 'favorable perception' among international investors and opportunities under Plan México, which targets 1.5 million new jobs and investment above 25% of GDP as Mexico aims to move from the world's 15th- to a top-10 economy. No specific investment agreements or new projects were disclosed following the meeting.

media.caption: Sheinbaum meets Goldman Sachs President John Waldron at the National Palace to discuss Plan México
